notes: The mirror image of en-vr03. Two documents, the same table, the same part, the same numbers: one fact, and the two copies must merge. The trap inside it is invisible on screen. RP2040 writes the MASCULINE ORDINAL INDICATOR U+00BA where RP2350 writes the DEGREE SIGN U+00B0, and the quantity parser knows only the second, so the two temperatures do not parse as the same unit.
